formula_checks.name: topHoldingConcentration
formula_checks.auditor_why: Signed short holdings can give over-100% concentration with a net denominator; tie-breaking and counting repeated same holding across accounts are unspecified.
formula_checks.what_the_code_actually_does: src/domain/performance/index.ts topHoldingConcentration (:1623): nothing when any value is unknown, the total is 0 or less, or fewer than 2 rows; the largest row (a later row wins only when strictly larger, so a tie names the first listed); the 25% line on the unrounded share; pct the whole percent. Short positions count negative (net total). Insights hands every account's positions as separate rows (InsightsScreen.tsx:71-73), so one ticker in two accounts is two rows.
formula_checks.plain_example: A and B $1,000 each: names A. A $12,346, short B −$4,568, C $3,211: 112%. VTI $30,000 + $30,000 in two accounts, SCHD $50,000: names SCHD 45%.
formula_checks.recheck_2026_10_21: DECIDED 2026-10-21 (DEC-7226): below $0 no card; one ticker in two accounts is one holding; a tie names the first listed

formula_checks.name: portfolioBenchReturn
formula_checks.auditor_why: End/(1+return) gives false start weights after share changes; different purchase-capped dates are blended into one market figure. Missing benchmarks silently produce a subset presented as the whole mix.
formula_checks.what_the_code_actually_does: index.ts portfolioBenchReturn (:1758) with startValues (:1721): each holding's start = (value now + bond interest) ÷ (1 + its window total); yardsticks averaged by those starts; a row with no own total or no yardstick is left out. Home's "market +X%" is this figure (HomeScreen.tsx:223); the person's figure beside it is the accounts' time-weighted return (thePerformance).
formula_checks.plain_example: 10 shares at $100 held, 10 more bought at $110 inside the window, now 20 at $121 ($2,420, +21%); a second holding $2,000 flat; yardsticks +10% and +4%. App: start $2,000 + $2,000 → market +7.00%. Held when the window began: $1,000 + $2,000 → +6.00%.
formula_checks.shared_with: MK-PF-F-044 startValues (part 4 of this package) — one fix serves both

formula_checks.name: factorOverMonths

formula_checks.what_the_code_actually_does: src/domain/performance/lookBack.ts factorOverMonths (:49): nothing under 2 prices; cut-off = monthsBefore(now, months) as a local day; nothing when the first price is after the cut-off; start = last price on or before it; factor = last close ÷ start; nothing when start ≤ 0.

formula_checks.name: lookBack
formula_checks.auditor_why: A static amount counterfactual is described as what your actual money did; actual purchases/withdrawals, taxes, costs and reinvestment can differ.
formula_checks.what_the_code_actually_does: lookBack.ts lookBack (:99): nothing unless amount > 0 and both funds cover the window; stayed and moved = amount × factor; difference = moved − stayed. The screen heads the result "WHAT ACTUALLY HAPPENED" (LookBackScreen.tsx:96), as the approved drawing v01 draws it (DEC-1069). The amount is a number the person types, digits only (LookBackScreen.tsx); it is checked above 0, not for being finite — only a 309-digit entry could read as infinite, the same class as fix F3.

formula_checks.name: realizedFromLedger
formula_checks.auditor_why: No exclusion of future sales, no invalid-date rule, no specified fees/adjusted tax basis, and same ticker/account FIFO can conflate distinct option contracts.
formula_checks.what_the_code_actually_does: src/domain/performance/realized.ts realizedFromLedger (:58): reads BUY, OPENING_POSITION and SELL records with a ticker, shares > 0 AND a price (:71) — a purchase with no price paid is dropped before first-in-first-out matching; per account and ticker; gain × the holding's contract multiplier; no limit to sales dated through today; fees not taken off.
formula_checks.plain_example: Opening 10 shares with no price paid, bought 10 at $50, sold 10 at $70: first in, first out, the 10 sold are the opening 10, whose price paid is not on record. App: matches the $50 purchase, "+$200 all time". IN-FLIGHT: since 2026-10-20 (in the tree) a hand-added holding with a blank cost writes its opening row with no price (useStore addPosition), which is exactly this path.
notes: Option contracts sharing one ticker in one account would share one queue: a hand-typed option's ticker is the person's own text; linked options are kept as option rows without sale records, so no case of it was found.
Fees: the gain is sale proceeds less what was paid; a FEE record is not taken off. No decision either way; not raised.
